address: 58 Soi Sathon 9, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok, 10200, Thailand
bio: Watching a cookery show is fun – but here, you get to enjoy the action live and in person. Here at Stage a 12-seater marble-topped counter sits in front of the kitchen, divided by a glass wall. As you enjoy the eight-course set dinner menu you can watch the kitchen team work with impressively choreographed and quiet efficiency. Prime ingredients form the basis of that menu; it could include succulent 14-day aged Barbary duck, abalone with black rice and a delicious liver sauce, or juicy lobster with crab salad....
